name: Grunge

influenced_by: Pacific Northwest punk and metal scenes
thrift-store/workwear practicality in a rainy climate

media.title: Nirvana, Nevermind (1991)
media.note: the album most credited with bringing the look to mainstream visibility

reacts_against: 1980s glam metal and corporate fashion's polish, dressing in cheap, practical, already-worn-looking clothes as a visible rejection of consumerist style.
revivals: cited repeatedly as a direct ancestor of indie sleaze and 2020s TikTok "grunge" styling

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Flannel shirts, ripped jeans, band t-shirts, Doc Martens, oversized sweaters, long unkempt hair
wiki_facts.key_colours: Earthy and muted tones: brown, army green, grey, burgundy, faded denim
wiki_facts.key_values: Anti-consumerism, authenticity, apathy, rebellion, social alienation, angst

findings: light — about 73% of the measured color is pale or near-white
mostly muted — about 89% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
